task: Making toast with cream cheese and smoked paprika
query: How do I make toast with cream cheese and smoked paprika?

goal.title: Make toast with cream cheese and smoked paprika
goal.description: Place a slice of bread in the toaster and toast it, then remove it and spread cream cheese over the toast with a knife in several strokes. Sprinkle smoked paprika from a shaker onto the cream cheese, blending a little of it in with the knife, before finishing with additional sprinkles of paprika held directly over the toast.
goal.final_state: The toasted bread is covered in cream cheese topped with smoked paprika and is held in hand near the counter; it has not been plated separately or eaten by the end of the video.
procedure: Put a bread slice into the toaster, lower the lever, and wait.
Remove the toast and spread cream cheese with repeated knife strokes.
Shake the reddish seasoning over the toast and finish spreading and sprinkling.

phases.description: Load a bread slice into the toaster and press the lever to start toasting.
Wait for the toast to finish toasting.
Remove the toast and spread cream cheese over it with a knife.
Sprinkle smoked paprika over the cream cheese to finish the toast.

notes: Video is dimly lit throughout; dense 3-8fps contact sheets and two overview sheets were reviewed for all 20 fine steps. Steps 5-13 are nine human-cut segments of visually similar repeated knife strokes spreading cream cheese; they are described with varied wording per the format rules but could not be visually distinguished stroke-by-stroke in the dim lighting, so some consecutive summaries are close in meaning (flagged, not an error). The interleaved order at steps 14-15 (a brief paprika sprinkle followed by one more cream-cheese spread that blends it in) and 16-19 (paprika shaker, then paprika while holding the toast directly) was confirmed from the frames rather than assumed from the recipe name. Fine track ends 0.58s before ffprobe_duration (166.667s), under the 1s tail-note threshold.
